name: Don't Debate This, N5800 minimum-diameter rocket (Mike Pasaretti), Black Rock

measured.data: barometric altimeters: Featherweight 56504 ft and PerfectFlite 56641 ft, averaged

notes: 13 in fin can (4.15 in) behind a 0.5 in shoulder; peak Mach about 3.2 is above the 3.0 top of the CFD table (the table's last point is carried up with the build-up's Mach trend); the fin's tip trailing edge is 0.55 in behind the root trailing edge and the file puts it 0.3 in behind the base; the 3D mesher takes an overhang of at most half the root's distance to the base, so the fin is moved 0.87 in forward (te_to_base 1.12 in instead of 0.25); its root leading edge is then 0.12 in ahead of the 0.5 in shoulder cone
source: RASAero II Comparisons with Altitude Data, https://www.rasaero.com/comparisons-alt.htm (C. E. Rogers); geometry, weights, motor and site from the example file shipped with the free RASAero II download, https://www.rasaero.com/dl_software_ii.htm (RASAero_II_Setup_Version_1.0.2.0.zip, Examples/DontDebateThisN5800MinDia.CDX1)
